UW Admissions Requirements

 First-Year Students
 

UW welcomes all first-time students to apply and considers each applicant based on
 academic achievement and completion of the High School Success Curriculum. Students
 with a cumulative, unweighted high school GPA of 3.00–4.00 (on a 4.0 scale) are assured
 admission, while those with a GPA of 2.50–2.99 are admitted with support.

High School Success Curriculum:

4 years English

4 years Math

4 years Science

3 years Social Sciences

4 years additional coursework

 Transfer Students
 

Transfer students thrive at the University of Wyoming! Transfer students who have
 obtained at least 12 post-high school transfer credits are eligible for UW's transfer commitments!

Transfer Students Admissions Requirements:

Cumulative 2.0 GPA (on an unweighted 4.0 scale)

12 transferable credit hours

*If less than 12 transferable credit hours, a high school transcript is required and
 ACT or SAT score is required if the student is less than 21 years of age.

UW Admissions FAQs

We want applying to UW to be simple and stress-free. This is an exciting step and
 it doesn’t have to be complicated! Below are some frequently asked questions to help
 guide you as you begin your UW admissions process.

 What materials should I have to apply?
 

The most important item to have on hand is your official high school transcripts.
 Transcripts will be sent to UW with your application. Beyond that, you’ll want any ACT or SAT scores and documentation of any previous
 college credits, if applicable.

 Is an ACT or SAT score required?
 

Currently, an ACT or SAT score is not part of the admissions requirements for the
 University of Wyoming. However, these scores can help you to earn more financial assistance.

 Is there an application deadline?
 

UW uses a rolling admission process for undergraduates, which means there’s no single
 application deadline. You can apply at any time leading up to the start of the next
 available semester, and applications are reviewed as they’re received. To be considered
 for financial aid, be sure to confirm your enrollment by May 1. Applying earlier is always encouraged to allow plenty of time for housing, onboarding
 and aid planning.

 

For graduate program deadlines, please visit our degree page search or contact the department direclty.

 Does applying to UW cost money?
 

Yes, there is a non-refundable $40 application fee that is processed when you submit
 your application.

 Who can I contact for further help?
 

Us! Contacting the friendly and helpful UW admissions team is quite simple. You can
 quickly chat with us via UW Answers. You can also call us at (307) 766-5160 or email us at admissions@uwyo.edu.

Applying takes less than 10 minutes!

Applying to the University of Wyoming is easy and straightforward. Our simple, user-friendly
 online application, ensures the process only takes a few steps and just about 10 minutes.
 Of course, if you do run into any questions UW Admissions is here to help you every step of the way. Whether you're a first-year, transfer
 or returning student, UW makes it easy to take the first step toward your future.
 Apply today and get started!

 Second Bachelor’s Degree Students
 

If you have already received a bachelor’s degree from the University of Wyoming and
 are interested in pursuing a second, your path to UW admissions looks a bit different.
 Our goal is to streamline this process, so you can quickly return to your academic
 goals. Our admissions team is here to help each step of the way.

Second Bachelor’s Degree Students

UW is proud to welcome and support our military and veteran students! Our admissions
 team is here to help you navigate the application process and connect with the resources
 you need. There are several student groups and programs on campus to help military
 and veteran students succeed both academically and personally!

Veteran Students

Welcome back to UW! Whether you have taken a quick academic break, or have stepped
 away for a longer period of time, we are here to help ensure a smooth re-enrollment
 to the University of Wyoming. There are different steps that need to be taken depending
 on your specific circumstances, and our team is here to provide all the assistance
 you need.

Returning Students

The University of Wyoming offers a non-degree admission status for students who wish
 to take courses without pursuing a degree. This flexible option allows you to explore
 interests and learn more about your passions. Applying for this path looks a little
 different, but is still straightforward and you have access to our admissions team
 for any guidance you may need.

Non-Degree Seeking Students

The University of Wyoming Casper is a unique partnership between UW and Casper College.
 Students from UW Casper that wish to attend the University of Wyoming in Laramie can
 work with admissions teams at both locations to help ensure a seamless transition.

Students from UW Casper

UW Online Education brings the University of Wyoming’s academic programs to learners
 across Wyoming and beyond through innovative distance learning. We offer flexible
 learning opportunities to allow for more students of all backgrounds and locations
 to access UW world-class education! Applying to be an online UW student is quick and
 easy.

Online Students

UW offers the unique opportunity for current juniors and seniors to take classes and
 earn credits while still in high school. Eligible students can apply to UW as dual-enrollment
 students and get a jumpstart on pursuing their academic goals!

Cost of Attendance

The University of Wyoming is proud to consistently rank as one of the most cost-effective
 universities in the nation for both resident and non-resident students. With competitive
 tuition rates and generous financial aid opportunities, UW offers affordable, high-quality
 education. You can easily estimate your cost of attendance using our online tools, helping you plan and prepare for your college journey.
